title: 第89章 桌上的博弈，顾清烟的纠结
content_zh:
第89章 桌上的博弈，顾清烟的纠结-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》

上午九点。

衡复片区的梧桐叶落了一地。

夏若冰提着文件袋走进藏锋小楼时，施工队已经开工。

一楼大厅铺了防尘布，靠墙堆着几箱茶器样品，箱体上贴着手写标签。

汝窑。

白瓷。

玻璃冷泡壶。

她把文件袋抱在身前，在门口停了半秒。

苏晚棠站在窗边，正和两个供应商说话。

她穿着米色风衣，手里拿着样品单，语速不快，每句话都落在价格、交付和责任上。

供应商年纪不小，被她问了几轮，只剩点头。

夏若冰走过去。

苏晚棠看了她一眼，把一份报价单递过来。

“苏州那家糕点坊，你先看看。”

夏若冰接过来。

报价单上，茶点分三档。

她看着上面的数字，想起林川那天在办公室里说过的话。

她的价值，不该一直被人按在原来的位置上。

夏若冰把报价单合上。

“我去谈。”

苏晚棠点头，没有多交代。

夏若冰转身去了临时会议室。

下午三点。

震旦大楼。

顾城推开林川办公室的门，神情不太好。

“陆骁有动作了。”

林川正在看太平洋桥资本的资料。

桌上摊着几份英文文件，旁边压着一张芯片封测产业链图。

“什么动作？”

“施工队、消防顾问、邻里关系，他都在打听。”

顾城往沙发上一坐，把手机扔在茶几上。

“这孙子还挺会挑。他想找能拖进度的地方。”

“消防一拖，施工就要停。邻里一投诉，街道就要上门。再加个历史风貌审批，工期能被他磨掉一大截。”

林川翻了一页文件。

“应该有人在背后教。”

顾城一怔。

“你也这么看？”

林川抬头。

“陆骁能想到消防，但他想不到把历史风貌、邻里、审批节奏绑在一起。”

“他没这个耐心。”

顾城骂了一句。

“我就说他那脑子不像突然充值了。平时打游戏都嫌新手教程长。”

他拿出手机，点开一张照片。

“今天中午拍到的。陆骁和一个姓许的男人吃饭。”

林川接过手机。

照片里，陆骁坐在靠窗位置，西装穿得很贵，坐姿却散。

他对面是个四十来岁的男人，灰色西装，细框眼镜，头发梳得齐整，不抢镜，也不弱。

“名字。”

“许泰。”

Nine o'clock in the morning.

The sycamore leaves in Hengfu area fell all over the ground.

When Xia Ruobing walked into Zangfeng's small building carrying a document bag, the construction team had already started work.

The hall on the first floor is covered with dustproof cloth, and there are several boxes of tea set samples stacked against the wall, with handwritten labels on the boxes.

Ru kiln.

White porcelain.

Glass cold brew pitcher.

She held the document bag in front of her and paused at the door for half a second.

Su Wantang was standing by the window, talking to two suppliers.

Wearing a beige trench coat and holding a sample sheet in her hand, she spoke slowly, with every word focusing on price, delivery and responsibility.

The supplier was quite young. After being asked several times by her, he only nodded.

Xia Ruobing walked over.

Su Wantang glanced at her and handed over a quotation.

"You take a look at that pastry shop in Suzhou first."

Xia Ruobing took it.

On the quotation list, refreshments are divided into three categories.

She looked at the numbers above and remembered what Lin Chuan said in the office that day.

Her value should not always be kept in its original position.

Xia Ruobing closed the quotation sheet.

"I'll go talk."

Su Wantang nodded without saying anything more.

Xia Ruobing turned around and went to the temporary meeting room.

3pm.

Aurora Building.

Gu Cheng pushed open the door of Lin Chuan's office, looking not very good.

"Lu Xiao has made a move."

Lin Chuan is looking at Pacific Bridge Capital's information.

There are several English documents spread out on the table, and next to them is a diagram of the chip packaging and testing industry chain.

"What action?"

"He's asking about the construction team, the fire consultants, the neighborhood relations."

Gu Cheng sat on the sofa and threw his cell phone on the coffee table.

"This grandson is quite picky. He wants to find a place where he can slow down the progress."

"If the fire department delays, the construction will be stopped. If the neighbors complain, the street will come to the door. Add in the approval of historical features, and the construction period will be shortened by a lot."

Lin Chuan turned over a page of documents.

"Someone should be teaching you from behind."

Gu Cheng was startled.

"You think so too?"

Lin Chuan raised his head.

"Lu Xiao could think of fire protection, but he couldn't think of tying the historical features, neighborhoods, and approval rhythm together."

"He doesn't have the patience."

Gu Cheng cursed.

"I just said that his brain doesn't seem to have suddenly recharged. Usually when playing games, novice tutorials are too long."

He took out his phone and clicked on a photo.

"This was taken at noon today. Lu Xiao was having dinner with a man named Xu."

Lin Chuan took the phone.

In the photo, Lu Xiao is sitting by the window. He is wearing an expensive suit but his posture is relaxed.

Opposite him was a man in his forties, wearing a gray suit, thin-rimmed glasses, and neatly combed hair. He didn't steal the spotlight, nor was he weak.

"Name."

"Xu Tai."
